==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I had a false awakening. During the false awakening, I felt my body move in the waking world. This activated my lucidity.

To avoid waking up, I grounded my senses within the dream. I summoned sand and water to touch. I entered sleep paralysis and maintained my dream state.

I became a cosmic god of purple flame. I flew through space spawning stars and universes. I woke up to the sound of my alarm.
